subject: Article about upgrading R to a new version

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Article about upgrading R to a new version
parts:
Hi everyone, we've written an article about upgrading to a new version of R, the potential problems it raises, and how to fix it:
  http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/upgrade-R.html

If you are running a Linux server with Shiny Server or Shiny Server Pro, this article can help you avoid problems when you upgrade R.

The issues with upgrading R are not common on Mac and Windows, and for regular non-server installations on Linux, but it may still be worth a read if this describes how you use R.

-Winston
